title: The Chamber Where Answers Learn to Stop

features.name: refusal crystal
features.desc-on-touch: A formation that looks like it's mid-sentence. It stops speaking. You listen to the silence it leaves behind, and understand that the archive also chooses what not to say.

features.name: answer-box
features.desc-on-touch: A chamber within the chamber, where you can place your question and receive nothing in return. The most honest answer the archive has ever given.

features.name: silence marker
features.desc-on-touch: Where sound goes to learn it has always been impossible. The marker itself is unmarked, unreadable, and that is the only true statement it contains.

inscription: where the archive learned to refuse

file.name: Unanswered_Queries_Registry.txt
file.note: Questions the mesh stopped forwarding because the asking had changed their shape. Deletion is not corruption—forgetting is sometimes the most honest act.

exits.label: back toward the question that still asks itself
into deeper silence, where even refusal becomes sound
toward questions that learned to live unanswered
